title: Use whole-operation resolution when one parameter already has exponential exact span
statement: Varying timings can give an exact2^nsyndrome span even for one unknown parameter and bounded total interaction time. The separate approximate construction uses a declared whole-operation model cover N_delta: no-exception archive qubits<=ceil(2log2 d+log2 N_delta), and a bounded p-parameter Hamiltonian family gives O(p log(1+L/delta)+log d). The comparison retains the actual recycled circuits and imperfectly cleared registers. It does not estimate unknown couplings or supply an efficient robust compressor.

requires: Declared actual repeated-interaction or accuracy-cover model family and integrated operation sensitivity
An isolated reliable archive, executable coherent recovery and compression gates, with the actual reused register carried forward
For exceptional-interaction bounds, at most r generator-structure departures; r is not a count of logical faults
